_comment: Operation: Blackout dedicated server egg. Import via Admin > Nests > Import Egg.
name: Operation: Blackout
author: akashsinhakvs@gmail.com
description: Co-op tactical FPS dedicated server (Godot 4.3, headless). Needs 1 allocation: the game uses it over UDP and the download website (which serves the Windows client) over TCP by default. Supports x86_64 and ARM64 (Ampere) nodes.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Operation: Blackout - Pterodactyl install script (runs on the node; picks x86_64 or ARM64 automatically)
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip ca-certificates > /dev/null
cd /mnt/server
ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "$ARCH" in
  aarch64|arm64) ZIP=OperationBlackout-Server-Linux-ARM64.zip ;;
  *)             ZIP=OperationBlackout-Server-Linux.zip ;;
esac
URL="${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
if [ -z "$URL" ]; then
  URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPO}/raw/${GITHUB_BRANCH}/dist/${ZIP}"
fi
echo "Node architecture: $ARCH - downloading $URL"
if curl -fL --retry 3 -o server.zip "$URL"; then
  rm -rf OperationBlackout-Server
  unzip -o -q server.zip && rm -f server.zip
  chmod +x OperationBlackout-Server/run_server.sh OperationBlackout-Server/blackout_server.* 2>/dev/null
  echo "Installed OperationBlackout-Server ($ZIP)"
else
  echo "Download failed (private repository?). Upload $ZIP in the File Manager and click Unarchive."
fi
mkdir -p server_data
exit 0

variables.name: Website port
variables.description: TCP port for the download website. "same" = use the game port number (the game uses UDP, the site TCP, so one allocation is enough). Never use 8080 (Wings).

variables.name: GitHub branch
variables.description: Branch to download the build from

variables.name: Download URL override
variables.description: Optional direct URL to a server zip (overrides repository/branch).
